risks.if_unproven: priced as non-working / scrap compressor value only

risks.proof: Technician gauge reading showing pressure in the line

Video of the unit plugged in to see if it powers on at all
Photos of all other sides of the unit, including the back and the missing front cover area
Close-up of the compressor data plate if accessible
response.reason: The seller already markets this as scrap, and the photo confirms a stripped, non-running-state unit with no verifiable capacity label, so it can be priced at worst-case scrap/parts value for a window AC of this size without further proof.
